verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncs that run "on the schedule or trigger you set" and sync data "on a recurring schedule" or when data changes, with run reporting and failure alerts. AI Decisioning agents also include scheduling rules. AI-native users can manage syncs through the official MCP server and the REST API. missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule types (cron/interval options), explicit evidence that schedules can be created or edited via MCP/API, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling.
